title: Weekly Status Report – Project Aurora (Release 3.2)

definitions.meaning: Milestone reported as done by the responsible team lead in the Monday update round.
Overall status on track; no escalation requested by any team lead.

context_note: Compiled from team updates received by Mon 10 Mar 16:00. Intended for internal circulation; prepared ahead of the Meridian steering-group review on Tue 11 Mar 11:00.
content:
OVERALL STATUS: GREEN. Release 3.2 of the Meridian Energy customer self-service portal is CONFIRMED for go-live on Monday 17 March.

Milestones. Development complete: Confirmed. Billing API v2 integration with Meridian: Confirmed. Data migration rehearsal: Complete (run on 6 March, 0 critical defects). User acceptance testing (UAT) with Meridian testers: scheduled 12–14 March. Go/No-Go meeting: 14 March 15:00.

Risks. R-11 Meridian UAT tester availability: Medium, mitigated by recorded walkthrough sessions. R-14 Payline payment-gateway TLS certificate renewal: Low, handled by Infra. No High risks open.

Key message for steering group: Aurora 3.2 is on track and confirmed for 17 March. No decisions required from Meridian at this time.
